summary: Calibration resolution, Leica XML locking, source/channel/Z/ROI alignment, checkpoint identity, and sampled-volume terminology are technically well controlled in the inspected code and retained artifacts. Acceptance is nevertheless blocked because the claim relies on RC6 segmentation, tracking, and end-to-end evidence that the repository's own provenance validator rejects at the reviewed commit: the production pipeline Git blob changed materially after evidence generation. The current candidate therefore lacks commit-bound execution evidence for its current pipeline semantics.

evidence: Command `git rev-parse HEAD` returned `681a5f341709262d6ed2d473846d6432f7b7a03f`.
`audits/runs/20260917-v571-production-superseding-rc2/manifest.json` records the same reviewed commit, `dirty_worktree: false`, and `mode: acceptance_candidate`.
`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:12857-12904` accepts Leica names only as `Project..._Series..._z..._ch00` and derives project, series, Z, channel, and stack identity.
`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:13201-13214` constructs the matching metadata path as `MetaData/Project..._SeriesNNN.xml`.
`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:13397-13414` rejects mixed Leica series before selecting metadata.
`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:13828-13835` resolves each discovered Leica specimen using its own project and series identifiers.
`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:13009-13042` explicitly converts m, um, and nm to micrometres and rejects unsupported or non-finite values.

`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:13056-13145` parses X/Y/Z dimensions, requires positive sizes, derives voxel spacing when needed, requires complete X/Y/Z calibration, and rejects X/Y anisotropy above 2%.
`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:13357-13363` reparses manifest-locked XML and requires both manifest XY and Z values to agree with it.
`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:9588-9600` resolves and saves calibration before loading the selected image and beginning segmentation in the single-image path.
`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:9771-9800` resolves and saves calibration before ROI preprocessing and stack segmentation in the batch path.
`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:335-336` defaults to automatic Leica calibration with metadata required.
`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:13420-13437` raises when Leica metadata is unavailable or invalid under the required-metadata policy; fallback is reachable only when metadata is not required.

`tests/test_saturn_v571_audit_blockers.py:341-360` covers invalid and replaced manifest-locked XML, while `tests/test_saturn_v571_audit_blockers.py:526-536` covers failure when required Leica XML is unavailable.
`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:1422-1477` rejects unparseable identities, mixed stacks, and duplicate Z indices, then orders inputs by parsed Z.
Retained `source_image_manifest.json` inspection found 88 KJ sources with unique Z 0-87 and 67 WT sources with unique Z 0-66; every record resolved to channel 0 and shape 1024x1024.
`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:13710-13751` records ordered position, path, filename, byte size, SHA-256, Z index, channel-resolution rule, stack key, and image shape.
`tests/test_saturn_v571_audit_blockers.py:283-301` asserts explicit channel provenance, source hashing, source shape, runtime device, and deterministic inference metadata.
`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:1480-1497` loads masks and rejects missing files, dimension mismatches, and empty masks.
`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:9785-9800` applies ROI and exclusion masks against the first stack image before preprocessing.
`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:13696-13708` copies and hashes configured ROI and exclusion-mask sources into the settings bundle.
Retained provenance inspection found KJ and WT ROI arrays of shape 1024x1024 matching all recorded image shapes, with 318768 and 250920 selected pixels respectively.

The retained settings manifests contain `roi_mask_source` and no `exclusion_mask_source`; their runtime bundles therefore document that no exclusion mask was configured rather than silently omitting an applied mask.
`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:913-949` requires a 64-character checkpoint digest, hashes the selected checkpoint, rejects mismatches, and authenticates probability caches against that digest.

Current checkpoint SHA-256 computed with the validated project interpreter is `7d49031dbcce31f0600c44146d9b5282b0df6e28bb1fc1bdde6ef2146ed15d25`, matching the production profile, retained runtime parameters, and `acceptance_provenance_manifest.json`.

The production profile Git-blob SHA-256 is unchanged between generation commit `6f9e73b170db121460ab82f28542d1ed1e8f96bb` and reviewed commit `681a5f341709262d6ed2d473846d6432f7b7a03f`: `1fcc10c2199295d57210283255ead78cbe9ab51071121552a3668e5d3887d902`.
`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:13629-13659` archives the active profile and checkpoint, and `sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:13763-13773` hashes them through the settings manifest.
A focused Python inspection recomputed every settings-artifact digest listed by `audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/provenance/acceptance_provenance_manifest.json`; all listed hashes matched.

The retained KJ and WT settings manifests each include runtime parameters, runtime environment, loaded profile, checkpoint, resolved calibration, microscope XML, ROI source, and ordered source-image manifest.
Both retained raw source inventories currently resolve to existing files: 88 of 88 KJ TIFFs and 67 of 67 WT TIFFs.
`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:14793-14824` explicitly constructs sampled ROI volume as 2D ROI area multiplied by nominal sampled depth.
`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:15645-15650` states that this denominator repeats the same 2D ROI through stack depth and is not anatomical tissue, seminal-vesicle, or whole-organ volume.
`audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/02_quality_control/data/specimen_sensitivity_artifact.json` records that sampled ROI volume is not anatomical organ volume.
`scripts/generate_v57_biological_comparison.py:29` and `scripts/generate_specimen_sensitivity_artifact.py:148-149` propagate the same limitation.

Running `.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts/validate_v571_evidence_provenance.py --stage-manifest audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/stages/visual_evidence_manifest.json --tracking-manifest audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/tracking/tracking_evidence_manifest.json --end-to-end-manifest audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/end_to_end/end_to_end_visual_evidence_manifest.json --profile production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json` failed with `ValueError: Git-blob changed after evidence generation`.

The validator reported generated pipeline blob `1f56404b2bd683065bb229e3aa5b3579fbf3470d58563967c9db0efc12f572a1` versus reviewed pipeline blob `021f6856fd5dfb24ece733ae9fa4112d737d4e802991d4e747882742f611d172`.
`scripts/validate_v571_evidence_provenance.py:42-52` defines any such post-generation Git-blob change as a provenance validation failure.
`audits/validation/v571_6f9e73b_validation.md` explicitly limits the retained stage, tracking, and end-to-end evidence to commits where the production pipeline blob remained unchanged.

Focused pytest execution was attempted with `C:\Users\dmishra\Desktop\sperm_project\.venv\Scripts\python.exe`, but pytest failed before collection with `FileNotFoundError: No usable temporary directory found` because the review environment is read-only.
No pass or fail conclusion was inferred from the infrastructure-limited pytest attempt.

findings.title: Retained execution evidence is not bound to the reviewed production pipeline
findings.impact: The current production candidate contains post-RC6 changes to the production pipeline, while its cited stage, tracking, and end-to-end evidence describes different pipeline bytes. Consequently, the artifacts cannot establish that calibration, source alignment, ROI application, checkpoint use, and resulting physical measurements operated together under the reviewed implementation.
evidence: The repository provenance validator failed at commit `681a5f341709262d6ed2d473846d6432f7b7a03f` with generated pipeline blob `1f56404b...` and reviewed blob `021f6856...`.
`audits/validation/v571_6f9e73b_validation.md` says the retained evidence stops at the last reviewed commit with an unchanged production pipeline blob.
The claim snapshot nevertheless cites the RC6 stage, tracking, end-to-end, and acceptance-provenance manifests as implementation evidence for the current production claim.
findings.recommendation: Create commit-bound validation evidence for the current pipeline semantics, or produce a narrowly scoped and justified superseding evidence package that exercises every changed calibration-dependent and provenance-dependent path. Require `scripts/validate_v571_evidence_provenance.py` or its superseding validator to pass against the exact reviewed commit before rerunning this role.

findings.title: Calibration and input provenance controls are otherwise strong
findings.impact: No silent stale-calibration path was identified in the production defaults or manifest-locked study path, and retained source, ROI, metadata, profile, and checkpoint identities are internally consistent.
evidence: `sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:13333-13383` requires the locked XML, verifies its SHA-256, reparses it, and compares both physical scales.
`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:14379-14411` repeats metadata hash and calibration agreement checks during manifest validation.
Focused artifact inspection confirmed unique Z indices, channel 0, matching 1024x1024 image/ROI shapes, valid metadata hashes, and the expected checkpoint digest for both retained specimens.
findings.recommendation: Preserve these fail-closed controls and include their focused tests in the superseding validation receipt.

limitations: No full image stack was run, as prohibited by the review request.
Focused pytest tests could not start because the read-only environment had no writable temporary directory; source inspection and retained evidence were used instead.
Other reviewers' output files were not opened or used.
The retained source TIFFs were checked for presence and manifest-level identity only; their complete contents were not rerun through inference.
recommended_follow_up: Regenerate or supersede the stage, tracking, end-to-end, and acceptance-provenance evidence at the exact current production pipeline commit.
Rerun the provenance-continuity validator and retain its successful command output in a current validation receipt.
Rerun focused calibration/provenance tests with the validated project interpreter in an environment providing a writable repository-local temporary directory.
Preserve explicit source-image, ROI, exclusion-mask, XML, profile, checkpoint, channel, Z-order, shape, and SHA-256 records in the superseding package.
